verdict.rationale: The evidence shows employee-facing equity activity only indirectly: a former employee describes exercising options through Carta (carta-comm-6), the API exposes option grants and fair market values (carta-docs-20, carta-docs-23), and an API can calculate the tax implications of a user exercising equity (carta-docs-13). Nothing in the pack documents a dedicated employee portal. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of an employee portal, vesting progress display, strike price shown to the employee, scenario or exit-value modeling of what equity could be worth, and independent hands-on corroboration.
